scope: Parent orchestration session from this stage start to its finish, not a complete per-theorem or project cost. The external solver runs are recorded separately in their individual reports. Only one wrapped command was measured; other local processes are not comprehensively covered.

time.scope: From start to finish of this invocation; not retroactive authoring time
time.aggregation: wrapper wall is direct elapsed time, not sum of children

memory.method: 10ms requested /proc process-tree RSS sampling; GNU time max RSS per command
memory.scope: Launched tool processes plus time launcher; excludes model-serving/desktop agent memory
memory.limitations: RSS sum may count shared pages more than once; sampling may miss brief peaks. GNU max RSS is an individual-process maximum, not summed concurrent memory.
memory.aggregation: max over sequential tools/children; overlapping child runs have no combined peak estimate

tokens.counting_rule: total=input+output; cache/reasoning are subsets; event_id union across wrapper and children

limits: Token usage includes cached input and shared conversation context; cannot attribute it per theorem. Local memory covers only wrapped commands, not all processes. Hosted inference memory and monetary cost unavailable. There are gaps between recorded stages.
